title: A site sets its own byline policy
description:
Satire uses pen names. The current rule is to attribute to AI and never invent an author.

```gherkin
Feature: Byline policy

  Scenario: A pen name is allowed where the site says so
    Given a site whose byline policy allows listed pen names
    When a piece is published under one of them
    Then the page shows that pen name

  Scenario: The default stays honest
    Given a site with no byline policy
    When an agent writes a piece
    Then it is attributed to AI
```
